issue: Duplicate account registration is not blocked
actual: Registered a second account using the already-registered email qa.tester.revive@example.com (different name "QA Tester Duplicate", different password). The app accepted it, showed "Account created successfully!" toast, and logged in as the new duplicate account instead of rejecting the registration.

evidence: Clicking "Create Listing" with all required fields (Title, Description, Price, Category, Condition, Location) empty kept the user on /create-listing and did not create a listing; focus moved to the first required field (Title).

Filled listing form with Price = -50 and all other required fields, then clicked "Create Listing". Submission was blocked: page remained on /create-listing, no success toast appeared, and focus returned to the Price field, indicating the negative price was rejected.

Created a listing "Test Vintage Chair" with a photo, description, price $125, category Furniture, condition Good, and location "Seattle, WA". App showed "Listing created successfully!" toast, redirected to My Listings, and the new listing appears there with photo, title, price ($125), and "Active" status.

actual: On My Listings, the only actions available per listing are "View", "Mark Sold", and "Delete" — there is no Edit control. Clicking the listing's image or title does not navigate to an edit form; "View" only opens the read-only public product page with a "Manage Your Listings" button that returns to the same My Listings list. Sellers cannot change title, description, price, or location of an existing listing.

Same as FT-2: My Listings only offers View, Mark Sold, and Delete actions for owned listings; there is no way to update any product information (title, description, price, category, condition, location, photos) after creation.

evidence: Logged in as QA Seller One (non-owner) and viewed Emma Green's listing "Mid-Century Modern Armchair" (prod-1). Only "Add to Cart" and "Message Seller" buttons were shown — no edit, delete, or "Manage Your Listings" controls were exposed for this listing owned by another user.
Clicked "Add to Cart" on Mid-Century Modern Armchair; cart icon badge in header updated to "1" and item was added.
Adding an item to cart triggered a toast notification "Added to cart!" and the cart icon badge count updated immediately to "1".
From the cart page, clicked "Send Purchase Request" for the item in cart; app showed "Purchase requests sent to sellers!" toast and cart was cleared (0 items) after the request was sent.

Seller deleted "Cart Test Lamp" listing after buyer had added it to cart. Logged back in as QA Buyer One and navigated to /cart via header cart icon click: cart shows "0 items" and "Your cart is empty" message, confirming the deleted listing was automatically removed from the buyer's cart rather than persisting as an orphaned/unavailable item.

Tested category filter (checked "Furniture" checkbox): item count dropped from 10 to 3, all 3 results were Furniture category items (Bookshelf, Coffee Table, Armchair). Cleared filters, tested condition filter (checked "Good" checkbox): item count dropped to 3, all labeled "Good" condition. Cleared filters, tested sort combobox by selecting "Price: Low to High": product grid re-ordered correctly in ascending price order ($35, $45, $55, $65, $95, $125, $175, $180, $285, $320). Price range and max distance sliders also present and functional in the Filters sidebar. Filtering/sorting correctly updates the "N items available" count and grid contents.

Typed "Lamp" into the "Search for items..." searchbox (without pressing Enter/submit). Results filtered from 10 items to 1 item: "Vintage Brass Floor Lamp" ($125, Portland OR) — the only listing whose title contains the keyword. Confirms keyword search matches product titles correctly.

Used browser_type with slowly=true (character-by-character) to type "Lamp" into the search box, with no Enter key press or form submission. Snapshot taken immediately after typing completed shows the item grid already filtered to "1 items available" showing only "Vintage Brass Floor Lamp" — confirms results update live/in real time as the user types, with no explicit search-submit action required.

Observed during FT-6 testing: clicking the "Furniture" category checkbox immediately updated the item count from "10 items available" to "3 items available" and the grid re-rendered with only Furniture items, with no separate "Apply filters" action needed. Same instant behavior observed when toggling the "Good" condition checkbox (10 → 3 items) and when clearing filters (3 → 10 items restored). Confirms filters apply and display results in real time.

Inspected img src/alt attributes for all 10 browse-page listings via DOM query. Each product has a distinct Unsplash image URL (no reused/generic placeholder images across products) and each img's alt text exactly matches its product title (e.g., "Vintage Brass Floor Lamp" → lamp photo, "Reclaimed Wood Bookshelf" → bookshelf photo, "Kids Wooden Train Set" → train set photo, "Handmade Macrame Wall Hanging" → macrame photo). Photo subject matter (lamp, bookshelf, armchair, coffee table, headphones, denim jacket, book set, yoga mat, train set, macrame hanging) is contextually appropriate and relevant to each listing's described item.
